Based on what I remember about your interests — **BCI decoders / nano neural interfaces**, **multi-agent & multimodal RL** (your Edinburgh MSc goal), and **AI/robotics for environmental sustainability** — here's a shortlist. I can't browse live, so double-check dates/CFPs before committing.

**Neural engineering / BCI**
- **IEEE EMBC 2023** (Sydney, late July 2023) — broad biomedical engineering, heavy neural-interface and nanotransducer content.
- **Graz BCI Conference** (biennial, Graz) — the most targeted BCI venue; strong on decoders and stimulation.
- **IEEE BioCAS** — where magnetoelectric/piezoelectric nanotransducer stimulation work tends to show up.
- **SfN Annual Meeting 2023** (Washington DC, November) — best for C. elegans connectome and imaging (GEVI vs. calcium imaging) work.
- Journals to watch: *Journal of Neural Engineering*, *Nature Neuroscience*, *Nature Biomedical Engineering* — the 2022–23 magnetoelectric-nanoparticle stimulation papers are directly in your proposal's space.

**RL / multi-agent / robotics** (Albrecht's group territory)
- **AAMAS 2023** (London, this week) and **AAMAS 2024** — core multi-agent RL venue.
- **CoRL 2023** (Atlanta, November) — robot learning, sim-to-real, multi-modal policies.
- **ICML 2023** (Honolulu, July) and **NeurIPS 2023** (New Orleans, December) — decoder/representation-learning and RL-adjacent work; also good for meeting Edinburgh/Pittsburgh people.
- **ICLR 2024** (Vienna, May) — submission deadline is usually late September, worth noting if you want to publish during your MSc.

**Sustainability + robotics**
- **ICRA 2024** (Yokohama) and **IROS 2023** (Detroit, October) — waste-collection robots, aerial ecosystem monitoring.
- **ACM COMPASS** / **IEEE Sustech** — smaller, but squarely on AI for sustainability.

**Cross-cutting, good for networking as an IEEE/ACM volunteer**
- **IEEE SMC** and **ACM SIGAI** workshop tracks; also the **DARPA N³**-adjacent program pages for nonsurgical neurotech funding signals.
